digest.component_or_area: filesystem store and fsck command modules
propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) currently live in fsck_repair.py but are imported by seven unrelated production modules, creating an inverted dependency where non-repair code depends on the repair module.
The three primitives have no logical connection to repair functionality and should be relocated to the stdlib-only leaf module gitutil.py to clarify architectural intent and eliminate the inversion.

All consumers of these primitives across fsck.py, fsck_scan.py, compact.py, bridge_repair.py, tracker_maintenance.py, and gitutil.py itself must be repointed to import from gitutil instead of fsck or fsck_repair.
Compatibility surfaces in fsck.py and fsck_repair.py must be preserved through re-exports so that existing tests binding these symbols as module attributes continue to work without modification.
